fields.Name: T186 - Users Bulk Selection Toolbar
fields.Description: Tests the multi-select + contextual bulk-action toolbar (toggleSelectAll/hasSelection/selectedCount) of UserManagement — a bespoke bulk-ops surface distinct from any generic grid selection.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'Users' sub-section. Each user row has a selection checkbox and there is a 'Select All' checkbox in the list header. Click the checkbox on one or two user rows (or Select All). Verify a contextual bulk-action toolbar appears showing the selected count and buttons for Enable, Disable, Assign Role, and Delete, plus a Clear control. Then click 'Clear' and verify the bulk toolbar disappears. Do NOT execute any bulk action. Success is the bulk toolbar appearing on selection and clearing on Clear. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Users list renders with per-row selection checkboxes and a Select All control
Selecting one or more users reveals a bulk-action toolbar with a selection count and Enable / Disable / Assign Role / Delete buttons
Clicking Clear removes the bulk-action toolbar
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
